abstract: A survey of 335 freelance creative workers reveals significant concerns about generative AI's impact on their work. The majority of respondents report negative effects across multiple dimensions: 73% believe GenAI is altering work quality, 68% feel their job security has been reduced, 61% perceive decreased value placed on their work, and 55% report declining financial compensation.
keyFindings: 73% of surveyed creative workers believe GenAI is altering the quality of their work
68% of respondents feel their job security has been reduced due to GenAI
61% report that the value placed on their work has decreased
55% report a decline in their financial compensation
methodology: Survey of 335 freelance creative workers. Specific details about sampling methodology, geographic scope, survey period, and data collection procedures not provided in excerpt.
qualifiers: Sample limited to 335 respondents; scope restricted to freelance creative workers; full methodological details and potential selection bias not specified in available excerpt.
